searchText: Altona seems to be running quite smoothly. Is there some list of open points/preconditions that remain before the next testnet? Something similar to the github issue for Altona? Technically, I don't think there is anything missing for a public testnet launch It's just a couple of operational things that needs to be done I believe. I expect that we can start working on that next week I'm in conversation with client teams. There is a little bit of stability work going on and other than that the blocker is some UX things (trying to make key management as close to mainnet as possible) I expect we announce a date monday/tuesday 🌊🏄‍♂️ Just a heads up that the cat is out of the bag: https://www.reddit.com/r/ethfinance/comments/hsqjyq/daily_general_discussion_july_17_2020/fycv699 lol I know I'm on a public forum. It's okay 🐈👜 I published the altona client metrics: https://ethresear.ch/t/ethereum-2-0-client-metrics-07-2020/7699 <@!557201004060213248> Although not as stable yet, Lodestar made some good progress. I'm currently syncing it on Altona, on my 4 year old laptop. Customized to have BLS enabled during sync, eth2stats support, and a few other minor changes. Getting about 5 slots/second (And after BLS optimization, would estimate 10-20 slots/second). Maybe worth benchmarking next? Great progress everyone :) Yes, great progress. I'll do another one for sure. All teams said they have optimizations in the pipeline, so it's worth repeating it or even make it a regular thing.
